prerequisites: Having passed at least 120 ECTS of the study plan.
Not having already exceeded the overall curriculum load for obtaining the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Contribute to the comprehensive training of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Promote the development of students' decision-making capacity and critical thinking.

syllabus_topics: Design of a training project, specifying educational objectives and professional activities for the internship agreement.
Particular conditions of each internship placement, recorded in an annex to the agreement.
Contract models to be signed by the student, two tutors, and the Center's Internship Program Manager.

assessment_methods.method: Description of the company, size, and importance
Relationship of tasks with university studies
Company tutor's evaluation of student performance (E1 Certificate)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.5 * Internship Report Grade + 0.5 * Monitoring Grade. A minimum of 4 points is required in both the Internship Report Grade and the Monitoring Grade to pass the course. The final grade must be greater than or equal to 5 to pass. If the minimum is not reached in either the Internship Report Grade or the Monitoring Grade, the maximum final grade will be 4 points. Extraordinary calls follow the same procedure as ordinary calls.
